label: PF Backlog 595
title: EDP-14: S3-compatible ObjectStore adapter + conformance tests (region/replication/versioning capabilities)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: No cloud object storage backend; only local FS planned.
brief.what_adds: S3-compatible adapter with tested capability detection.
brief.who_feels: Platform/enterprise admins and anyone storing run artifacts.

objective: Deliver an S3-compatible ObjectStore adapter with capability detection (region, replication, versioning) validated by the shared conformance test harness.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter passes the shared conformance suite against MinIO in CI
Capabilities (region/replication/versioning) exposed via capability probe API
Language rule L1 (Go) passes scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py
No credentials logged; env-based config only
approach: Define S3 client wrapper, implement interface methods, add capability detection via GetBucketVersioning/GetBucketReplication, wire MinIO-backed tests.
risks: MinIO/S3 test doubles and credential handling for CI
Go/Python language boundary if service stays Python
rollback: Remove the new Go package; no existing behavior depends on it yet.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Implement S3 adapter in Go against the provider-neutral ObjectStore interface (BI-PF-1299); reuse the local adapter patterns and conformance harness; add capability probing for region/replication/versioning.
conflict_findings: Shared conformance harness touched by BI-PF-1305; coordinate harness extension points
duplication_findings: No S3 adapter exists yet in candidate code (Python registries are unrelated)
Conformance harness delivered by BI-PF-1299; do not rebuild
analysis.rationale: Second adapter proving the provider-neutral interface; conformance harness already planned, so this is a focused extension.
assumptions: S3-compatible target is MinIO or AWS S3; harness from BI-PF-1299 is stable enough to extend
risks: MinIO/S3 test doubles and credential handling for CI
Go/Python language boundary if service stays Python
missing_info: Which S3-compatible providers are in-scope for launch (AWS only vs MinIO/GCS interop)
Where the Go binary ships relative to the Python API process

context_review.reason: Interfaces and harness are specified by dependencies; provider choice is the only open decision.

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-14: S3-compatible ObjectStore adapter + conformance tests (region/replication/versioning capabilities)
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: private buckets, least-privilege credentials, lifecycle/versioning where required; explicit region/backup/replication capability metadata.
Signed URLs only after authorization, constrained to object/method, short TTL.
Provider config stays inside the adapter; conformance suite passes (wrong-region, versions, delete, restore).
11 Go interfaces defined in internal/storage/ with godoc and compile-time assertions
Conformance harness package exposes embeddable test suites per interface
In-memory reference adapter passes all conformance suites
scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py passes (Go-only)
config/test-matrix.json extended with storage-conformance rows
Adapter passes all BI-PF-1299 conformance tests
Symlink escape and path traversal attempts denied
Writes are atomic (no partial object visible on crash simulation)
Checksum mismatch on read detected; size limit enforced with clear error
Passes scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
L1 Go rule passes language_rule_review.py
lifecycle rules + optional object lock/immutability; versioning where required.
delete reconciles DB record, object versions, replicas and backups per retention; tenant deletion includes objects.
orphaned-object and lifecycle-expiry tests pass.

api_impact.reason: retrofit assessment (ADR-0007): no external API consumer recorded; treated as internal until an API surface is required (then set needs_api=true with routes)
